translations.web: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
translations.bsb: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
translations.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
